snippet.title: BOARDING DENIED - Gameplay | The world ends in 12 days
snippet.description:
BOARDING DENIED gameplay: 12 days before impact, you stamp BOARD or DENIED at Boarding Window 7. Out now on Steam, PS5, Android and Windows.

🎮 Get it now:
Steam (PC, 9.99 EUR): https://store.steampowered.com/app/5391840/
PlayStation 5 (9.99 EUR): https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/10021101
Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pigeong.boardingdenied
Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9ppl21q38q1m
Trailer: https://youtu.be/hbGN8NnnbUU

November 2041. The Wormwood meteorite hits Earth in 12 days and the last evacuation ships are boarding. You are the clerk at Boarding Window 7: you check the ticket, identity card, medical certificate and professional record, then stamp BOARD or DENIED. Every stamp is a life.
• Four documents to check for every person
• Two stamps: BOARD or DENIED
• 12 days until impact
